cohort: 11,162 deliveries between 2009 and 2019 at one urban tertiary medical center
finding: The study found that daytime delivery, advanced maternal age, obesity, hypertension, previous cesarean delivery, multiparity, pre-eclampsia, and HELLP syndrome were independently associated with increased odds of unscheduled cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The study investigated factors associated with unscheduled cesarean delivery, finding associations with various maternal and pregnancy-related factors.
